name: How do I choose slip-resistant tile for my garage floor?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose slip-resistant tile for my garage floor?

acceptedAnswer.text: A smooth tile will become very slippery when wet, so choosing a tile with an appropriate slip-resistance rating is essential for garage safety. Look for porcelain tiles with a dynamic coefficient of friction (DCOF) rating of 0.42 or higher, which indicates safe traction under wet conditions. Tiles featuring an orange-peel, matte, or light slate texture provide solid foot grip when wet snow or motor oil tracks inside. Choosing the right texture balances slip prevention with easy cleaning, as overly rough surfaces can trap dirt and make mopping difficult.
acceptedAnswer.description: Select porcelain tile with a matte or textured finish and a wet DCOF rating of 0.42 or higher to maintain traction when tracking in snow, rain, or fluids.
